name: LANCER IX

specs.notes: Specs are from the JDM catalogue (goo-net). Other versions: the JDM RS (stripped) is 1,320 kg with 407 Nm (41.5 kgf.m) @ 3000 rpm and a 5-speed (2.785/1.950/1.444/1.096/0.761); its final drive was not reliably extracted. US-market Evolution IX: 286 hp @ 6500 and 289 lb-ft (~392 Nm) @ 3500 rpm; the US base car has a 5-speed and the US MR a 6-speed (newatlas). The Australian car is 206 kW / 355 Nm. The manufacturer did not publish a top speed (JDM cars were limited), so it is null. Weight distribution was not found.

garage.blurb: The last of the turbo four-door brawlers: 280 PS from a 2.0 turbo, an active centre diff that pulls the nose into the apex, a six-speed. Brutally quick through the twisties.

interior.notes: The model's: seats, dash, steering wheel, gear lever (works). Left-hand drive (the model's).

source.license: CGTrader purchase (the listing matched was removed: licence unconfirmed)

limitations: The model is left-hand drive; the numbers are the JDM GSR's (right-hand drive in Japan).
One texture (33690_63.jpg) isn't in the package.
The 60/40 weight split is an estimate.
